description: A smartphone lies on the bed in front of a loosely coiled white charging cable, with a pillow propped up at the head of the bed. The right hand reaches in from the right, picks up the phone, and holds it near the cable while the left hand comes in from the left to grasp the cable’s connector; the left hand guides the plug into the phone’s charging port as the right hand steadies the phone, then the right hand sets the now-connected phone down to the right.
